annotation.title_clean: Decision No 1/2017 of the Committee established under the Agreement between the European Community and the Swiss Confederation on mutual recognition in relation to conformity assessment, of 28 July 2017
annotation.title_en: Decision No 1/2017 of the Committee established under the Agreement between the European Community and the Swiss Confederation on mutual recognition in relation to conformity assessment, of 28 July 2017
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Committee established under the EC-Swiss Confederation Agreement on mutual recognition in relation to conformity assessment
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 323/51
annotation.summary_en: EU–Switzerland joint committee decision amending the mutual recognition agreement on conformity assessment. It updates sectoral chapters (medical devices, pressure vessels, radio, ATEX, electrical equipment/EMC, measuring instruments, medicinal products, lifts, explosives) to reflect new EU directives. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Replaces Chapter 4 on medical devices with updated provisions and registration/information exchange rules
Updates chapters on pressure vessels, radio equipment, ATEX, electrical/EMC, measuring instruments, lifts, explosives to 2014 EU directives
Establishes equivalent obligations for EU and Swiss economic operators and market surveillance cooperation
Sets safeguard procedures for non-compliant or risky products
Takes effect on the later signature date (27/28 July 2017)
